name: github-broker
description: Run the host's gh login for the jail against this workspace's GitHub repositories, its remotes and any its config lists under brokered.github.repos, as approved at launch, and only under a read grant in config (brokered.github.grants; with none, every call is refused): reads run; PR and issue creation under a create-pr or create-issue grant, a workflow run on the default branch under a dispatch-workflow grant, and writes to a PR or issue in the workspace's working set (what the agent created, or what a human added with yolo approve --add), run unasked, a merge excepted; every other write files a request the host answers with yolo approve (once, --for a time, or --add), and every call is audited on the host (yolo audit).
